SWEEPING HIGH-AERIAL — camera pulled high and far back, the entire brick range unfurling tier after tier below, each slope-plate ridge fading toward a hazed trans-blue horizon, the land enormous.

VALLEY-FLOOR-LOOKING-UP — camera pressed low on brick-meadow plates, tilting steeply upward at towering slope-brick peaks flanking both sides, foreground stud-grass leading the eye to snow-capped summits.

RIDGE-LINE PANORAMA — camera positioned on a near serrated brick crest looking along the marching ridgeline as layered slope-plate ranges stack and fade behind, a lone figure dwarfed on the foreground edge.

THROUGH-A-SLOT-CANYON — camera deep inside stacked-plate canyon walls pressing close on both sides, a narrow sliver of brick-sky visible far above, the sculpted passage pulling the eye forward into shadow.

REFLECTION-IN-A-STILL-LAKE — camera flat at the trans-blue tile lake-shore, brick peaks mirroring perfectly across the still surface, foreground round-plate shore-rocks anchoring the near-symmetrical composition below.
SUMMIT-OVERLOOK VISTA — camera perched at the highest slope-brick rim, the foreground crest sharp and near, everything beyond dropping away tier after tier into deep brick-valley distance below.

AERIAL-RIVER-BEND — camera directly overhead watching a trans-blue plate river wrap a great horseshoe around a stacked-plate rock-pinnacle, canyon walls receding outward, a god-eye overview of enormous brick scale.
WORM'S-EYE-UP-A-REDWOOD — camera flat on the stud-soil floor craning straight up immense brown round-brick trunk-columns, the canopy of green plate-leaves a tiny circle of light impossibly far above.
CLIFF-EDGE-VERTIGO-DOWN — camera at the sheer slope-brick lip looking straight down the face to a trans-blue river thread far below, a foreground rim of tile-rock grounding the dizzying descent.

LOW-FOREGROUND-ROCK-TO-DEEP-PEAKS — camera low behind a detailed round-plate boulder-field, depth stacking across a brick-valley to distant snow-capped slope-plate peaks glowing against a pale sky-plate horizon.

SWEEPING HIGH-AERIAL DUSK — camera high over the full brick range as long slope-shadows streak valley floors, tiers of ridgelines burning warm in angled light, the sheer territorial sweep overwhelming.

VALLEY-FLOOR LOOKING UP AT CANYON WALLS — camera on the flat stud-gravel floor tilting up immense stacked-plate walls rising on both sides, a thin ribbon of sky-plate barely visible between the towering faces.

RIDGE-LINE INTO FOG — camera on the near brick crest as the marching ridgeline dissolves into grey plate-mist behind, the foreground slope-rock sharp and textured, distance swallowed in soft obscurity.
DEEP-SLOT-CANYON TWIST — camera inside a turning stacked-plate passage where walls curve away into darkness, a single shaft of sky-plate light angling down the sculpted brick corridor far ahead.

LAKE-EDGE WIDE MIRROR — camera low and wide at the trans-blue tile lake, the full brick mountain panorama reflected end-to-end, foreground shore-tiles ripple-free, near-perfect symmetry splitting land and water.
SUMMIT-LOOKING-ACROSS-TO-EQUAL-PEAKS — camera at one high slope-brick summit, a deep brick-valley yawning below, equal-height peaks rising across the void, the midair space between them the subject.

AERIAL-RIVER-DELTA — camera high over a splaying trans-blue plate river fanning into braided channels across flat stud-plain, distant slope-brick ranges framing the horizon, the floodplain reading vast and open.

WORM'S-EYE-CANOPY-BURST — camera on the forest-floor stud-tiles shooting straight up where multiple brown round-brick trunks converge overhead, green plate-canopy exploding outward in all directions above.
